_doc: What THIS app declares it needs the privileged shell channel for: the same block every app keeps in build.json::privileged_channel, kept in this file because this app's build.json is an input of the Nix-on-Droid rootfs library's content address (build.json::forks.nixdroid.bootstrap.artifact.identity_files): editing build.json would republish the ~400 MB payload for a settings declaration. libs/shizuku-adb-debug-tools/build.gradle reads build.json first and this file when build.json has no such block, into BuildConfig.CHANNEL_NEEDS_B64; the Declared needs section of the ADB Shell page (Settings > ADB Shell) lists it as written. A terminal runs no local server of its own, so its page shows none.

needs.label: rish: a shell-uid shell inside the terminal
needs.why: The terminal exports rish into its rootfs, so a command typed there can run as the shell user through the SuperApp bridge or Shizuku.

needs.label: Fleet tooling from the terminal
needs.why: Agents and scripts in the terminal use rish for pm, am and settings calls the proot cannot make itself.
